meanings.meaning: A prophet is a person who speaks for God. God gives him a message, and he tells it to the people in God's name, sometimes about what will happen later.
A false prophet is someone who pretends to speak for God but does not. He is an impostor who fools people with his own made-up messages.
The Prophets are the writings of the prophets, the messages God gave through them. Together with the Law of Moses, they make up the Scriptures of the Old Testament.
